data.fund_type: An open ended scheme, listed on the Exchange in the form of an Exchange Traded Fund (ETF) investing in physical gold
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of Nippon India ETF Gold BeES is to provide returns that, before expenses, closely correspond to the returns provided by Domestic price of Gold through physical gold. There can be no assurance or guarantee that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved.
data.asset_allocation: Physical Gold or Gold related Instruments as permitted by SEBI from time to time: 95-100% Money Market Instruments-0% to 5% (with maturity not exceeding 91 days), including Tri-party repo on G-sec or T-bills, cash & cash equivalents, Securitized Debts
